entities.name: PMID:25090165
observations: 2014 in-vitro study compared dexamethasone diffusion through control and Staphylococcus epidermidis biofilm-coated silicone-hydrogel contact lenses.
Biofilm-coated lenses reduced dexamethasone diffusion by up to 88% versus controls; tested lotrafilcon A and methafilcon lenses over 18 hours.

entities.name: Biofilm inhibits lens dexamethasone diffusion
observations: In vitro, S. epidermidis biofilm on silicone-hydrogel contact lenses reduced dexamethasone diffusion by up to 88% relative to controls; retrieved evidence did not provide p-values or group-level statistics.
